thread:
maya: Quick question re saved-view ownership lifecycle for console route/model views — want to avoid orphaned saved queries that keep routing pins & quotas attached. Do we auto-transfer ownership on role change, or show a transfer nudge?

alex: Auto-transfer is scary. We should surface an explicit transfer flow + a clear warning that routing pins and quota allocations will move.

jon: Agreed. Also add telemetry: show last-used timestamp + % of route traffic and recent token burn so folks can triage stale views.

katie: UX idea: when someone pins a saved view to a route, show a small modal: 'Pin will apply routing/quota to these models' + an estimated cost delta. :money_with_wings:

maya: Cost delta sounds good — where does that estimate come from? Recent telemetry per route/model? @alex any thoughts on API surface?

alex: We can approximate with recent telemetry: tokens_per_minute * model_unit_price, plus prefix cache hit adjustments. Push a computed field on the views GET: `estimated_burn`. Example response shape we discussed:

```json
{
  "id": "v_123",
  "owner": "maya",
  "pinned_routes": ["route_53"],
  "model_ids": ["rwd/gptx-8b"],
  "estimated_burn": "120 tokens/min (~$0.03/hr)",
  "last_used_ts": "1777777000"
}
```

jon: Small API debate: should `owner` be an explicit field or inferred from last modifier? Inferring leads to accidental flips if someone edits a filter.

katie: I vote for explicit `owner` that only changes via a transfer endpoint. We can add `delegated_to` for team-level access without transferring ownership.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: saved-views-service v1.42 deployed — GET /views rate-limit bumped (500 -> 1000 rps).

raquel: For rollouts: when we propagate default saved-views across orgs, new orgs should get team-owned defaults, while existing orgs keep the original owner metadata to avoid surprises.

sam: Edge-case: what happens to routing quotas when the owner leaves the company? Proposal: freeze quotas and mark views as `stale_owner` after 90d of inactivity, and auto-notify org admins.

maya: Good call. Console should show a badge 'stale owner' with one-click remediation: transfer, archive, or request auto-transfer. Also we need audit log events for transfers and pin/unpin.

alex: Implementation notes: add POST /views/:id/transfer (body: new_owner_id + reason) and GET /views/:id/estimate. Ownership checks in middleware; also enforce admin overrides for org-level transfers.

jon: Telemetry events we should emit: `view.pinned`, `view.transferred`, `view.stale`, each with route_id, model_ids, owner_id, and estimate at time of event. That will let us build alerts / dashboards.

katie: :thumbsup: I'll mock the transfer modal + stale badge flows. Can we prioritize the transfer UX and estimate surface in the next sprint?

maya: Please add to backlog. @sam can you confirm the admin notification channel (email vs slack vs console alert)? Also want product + infra sync tomorrow to align.

sam: Booked 10:00am PT in calendar. I'll confirm notification integrations and what auto-notify payload looks like.

maya: :eyes: thanks all — I'll capture decisions and spin up a short spec with API contract, telemetry events, and UX mock links.
